title: Graph-RMS: reproducibility package for training-free and class-count-free spectral–spatial region discovery in hyperspectral remote-sensing images
description: Graph-RMS is a training-free workflow for discovering coherent spectral-spatial regions in complete hyperspectral remote-sensing scenes without requiring labelled training pixels or a predefined semantic class count during scene processing. The software builds a sparse reciprocal local graph, estimates Gaussian spectral-spatial affinities, applies damped graph diffusion, extracts fine representation-space modes, performs spatial cleanup, and consolidates mode prototypes with partition-based safeguards. This reproducibility package contains the implementation used for the study, frozen primary and automatic-selector configurations, curated per-scene partitions, main and supporting result tables, figure assets, provenance records, and scripts for environment checks, reruns, audits, and table/figure export. Nine public benchmark scenes are documented, including the independent Trento holdout for the primary procedure. Raw hyperspectral cubes are not redistributed; acquisition instructions and expected filenames are provided separately. The package distinguishes true-class-count baselines from class-count-free HDBSCAN and same-graph Leiden comparisons, and records limitations including scene-dependent scale sensitivity, over-segmentation, memory demand, and the retrospective status of automatic selection on Trento.
